name: fyl-at

scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:assets && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .build --assets .build/assets
scripts.deploy: npm run build:cli && npm run build:assets && node scripts/check_secrets.mjs && wrangler deploy --assets .build/assets --tag v$npm_package_version --message "fyl $npm_package_version" && python3 scripts/smoke.py --pages
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run check && npm test && npm run test:cli && npm run build

//: test:cli runs the Python tests (tests/test_*.py) in parallel; npm run test:cli -- test_cli runs one module.
test:rust runs the Rust CLI unit tests with the toolchain of cli-rs/rust-toolchain.toml. It is not part of ci,
